title: If battery dies during bolus delivery you get full bolus anyway but AAPS does record only part of it
symptom: During bolus delivery, the pump battery died, and AAPS recorded only 1.1 U delivered, but the pump history shows the full 8.7 U was delivered. This can lead to overdose if unnoticed.
cause: The user was not using the v2 driver; the main R driver does not use history and any connectivity problem leads to wrong data.
fix: Use the v2 driver instead of the main R driver.
evidence_quote: and you are not using v2 driver anyway. main R driver doesn't use history and any problem with connectivity leads to wrong data almost everytime
